999008199.text:
さすがに、ここらへんまで遠出すると
なかなかの緊張感っすわ

localizations.en: I've got to admit, coming this far out has me feeling pretty tense.

999008199.text: こんな時でもないと、なかなか来ないからね

localizations.en: Well, we rarely get the chance to come here otherwise.

999008199.text:
くれぐれも用心してね。
この辺りは魔物も気性が荒いのが多いから

localizations.en: Stay on your guard, everyone. The monsters around here tend to be quite aggressive.

999008199.text: 全部倒して料理して、姉様に献上する

localizations.en: I'll defeat them all, cook them, and present them to you.

999008199.text:
海から遠いせいか、風がぜんぜんないね。
日差しも強いし、汗が噴き出てきそうだよ

localizations.en: Being so far from the sea, there's no breeze at all. And with this strong sun, I'm about to start sweating buckets.

999008199.text: 確かに、ちょっと暑いね……

ベップ。お前さん、黒成分多めだけど、
こういう天気だと少し暑くないかい？

localizations.en: Hey Bepp, with all that black you're wearing, aren't you feeling the heat in this weather?
It is hot, I'll give you that.

999008199.text:
やっぱりそうなんだ。
もちっと涼しい色合いの服を着たらどうだい？

localizations.en: Thought so. Why not try wearing something in a cooler color?

999008199.text:
ううん、そういうわけにはいかない。
これは、島で亡くなったみんなを弔うための服だから

localizations.en: No, I can't do that. These clothes are to mourn those who died on the island.

999008199.text:
あの「光る怪物」にかたき討ちを果たすまでは、
私はこのままでいい

localizations.en: Until I have my revenge against that glowing monster,I'll remain as I am.

999008199.text: その心意気はあっぱれなんだけど

せっかくべっぴんさんなんだから、
もっと色々おしゃれをさせたいのに

localizations.en: It's such a waste! You're such a beauty, I'd love to dress you up in different styles.

999008199.text:
それは分かるな～！
ベップ、そういうのにぜんぜん興味ないんだもん

localizations.en: I know exactly what you mean! Bepp's never shown any interest in that kind of thing.

999008199.text:
……姉様がどうしてもというなら、
たまには着てもいいわ

localizations.en: ...If you absolutely insist, I suppose I could wear something else occasionally.

999008199.text: ホント！？　じゃあ、ど・う・し・て・も！

よーし！　今度似合いそうなのを見繕ってあげるよ！
粋なベップに仕上げてみせるさ

localizations.en: Alright! I'll pick out something that suits you next time! Just wait 'til you see how stylish we can make you look!
